release_notes:
# Vidrick AI Transcriber 4.3.3 updater improvements

- Check for and install updates directly from the activation screen, including when a license is expired or a required update blocks sign-in.
- Clearer update availability and download status, with retryable failure messages.
- Strengthened installer verification and safer update handoff.
- All 4.3.2 trial, subscription, payment-sync, and transcription licensing protections remain in place. Updating does not grant transcription access.

Already blocked on 4.3.1? That older app cannot receive the new update screen remotely. Close Vidrick and run this signed installer once, then sign in if prompted. Subsequent releases can be reached from the new activation-screen updater without signing in first.

This release does not change transcription models, speaker identification, or local audio processing. Recordings stay on your computer. Windows may ask for administrator permission during installation.
